items.stem: Which Systems Manager feature lets you get a shell on an instance without opening inbound SSH?

options.rationale: Correct: Session Manager provides shell access via the SSM agent, no open ports.
Run Command executes scripts but is not an interactive shell session.
Patch Manager applies patches, not shells.

items.explanation: Correct: Session Manager gives portless shell access.

items.stem: Which TWO are required for an EC2 instance to be managed by Systems Manager? (Select TWO.)

options.text: The SSM Agent installed and running
options.rationale: Correct: the agent is required for SSM management.

options.text: An instance role granting SSM permissions
options.rationale: Correct: the instance needs IAM permissions for SSM.
A public IP is not required (VPC endpoints work).
Open SSH is not required and is discouraged.

items.explanation: Correct: the agent and an instance role are required.

items.stem: How should a sensitive database password be stored in Parameter Store?

options.text: As a SecureString parameter encrypted with KMS
options.rationale: Correct: SecureString encrypts the value at rest with KMS.
User-data is readable and not a secret store.
A public bucket leaks the secret.
